# Symbiote UI

> Runtime UI library for agent-driven professional interfaces. No build step.

Symbiote UI is a Web Component library that lets AI agents create, control,
and theme Studio-grade interfaces at runtime through a programmatic API.
Unlike static "agent skill" instructions, Symbiote UI provides a live runtime
where agents directly assemble UI from JSON, manage component lifecycle via
WebSocket, compose cascading themes from presets, and orchestrate multi-step
UI transactions with automatic rollback.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/rnd-pro/symbiote-ui/blob/main/README.md)
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/rnd-pro/symbiote-ui/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Agent Skills

- [symbiote-ui](skills/symbiote-ui/SKILL.md): Runtime UI Controller, WebSocket protocol, Dynamic Component Registry, Agent Intent Orchestrator, WebMCP Bridge.
- [symbiote-ui-theming](skills/symbiote-ui-theming/SKILL.md): Cascade Theme System, ThemeFactory presets, Motion layer, State-to-Cascade CSS induction.

## Schemas

- [runtime-ui-v1](schemas/runtime-ui-v1.json): JSON schema for runtime UI trees.
- [agent-intent-v1](schemas/agent-intent-v1.json): JSON schema for transactional agent intent sequences.
- [component-descriptor-v2](schemas/component-descriptor-v2.json): JSON schema for component descriptors with SSR and WebMCP metadata.
- [theme-rule-block-v1](schemas/theme-rule-block-v1.json): JSON schema for composable theme rule blocks.

## Component Catalog

- [custom-elements.json](custom-elements.json): Full Web Component catalog with properties, attributes, events, and theme aliases.
- Graph explorer dual mode: register `graph-explorer-shell`, `node-canvas`,
  `canvas-graph`, and `graph-node`; use `createGraphViewModeController`
  from `symbiote-ui/ui` or `symbiote-ui/canvas` to switch structured/flat
  renderer visibility, fit/focus, path style, and host-owned flat graph models.
